headline: Iraq Delays Up to 30 Million Barrels of Crude Oil Shipments
summary: Iraq's SOMO has delayed the loading of between 20 and 30 million barrels of crude oil cargoes originally scheduled for this month. Only some cargoes will be loaded during the first ten days of December.
why: Iraq is one of the largest crude oil exporters in OPEC, and significant shipment delays from state oil marketer SOMO can disrupt international energy supply chains.

entities.name: State Organization for Marketing of Oil

why_moved: A major delay in crude oil loadings from Iraq restricts immediate physical supply availability for buyers.
